name: Commerce Data Insights
description: Interactive sales analytics and model-based monthly revenue forecasting with SQLite persistence.
summary: Cleaned order data supports revenue, product, region, and time-based analysis. A separate forecasting workflow compares regressors and exports predictions and evaluation results.
architecture: CSV uploads pass through cleaning into SQLite. Streamlit analytics pages use Pandas for revenue, product, and regional summaries. Scikit-learn compares Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, and Linear Regression before producing forecasts and exportable results.

capabilities.name: Commerce analytics
capabilities.description: Inspect revenue, products, regions, trends, and filtered KPI summaries.

capabilities.name: Revenue forecasting
capabilities.description: Train and evaluate three regressors, then export future monthly predictions.

stack.usage: Multipage views guide uploads, filters, model training, and CSV downloads.
Python separates loading, database, analytics, and forecasting responsibilities.
DataFrames clean order data and aggregate revenue by period, product, and region.
Numerical operations support feature engineering and regression calculations.
Cleaned sales records are stored locally for analytics and forecasting.
Charts expose KPI trends, product and regional performance, and forecast diagnostics.
Three regressors are trained and compared using MAE, RMSE, and R-squared.

architectureConnections.description: Validated and cleaned order records are persisted locally.
Model diagnostics and forecasts appear as interactive figures.

evidence.notes: Reviewed repository README and available dependency manifests. Capabilities describe implemented workflows; roadmap items are excluded.
